YOU ARE THE MONSTER. Five levels of armed hunters. Kill them all before time runs out.

STAY OUT OF THE LIGHT  they only see you inside the cone in front of them. Pale = calm, yellow = suspicious, red = shooting. They fire every 2 seconds; 3 hits and you're dead. Moving fast makes you harder to hit but louder.

MOVE  slap and push the ground, walls and trees. Let go to leap.  TURN  right thumbstick.

KILL  swipe through them (hits on someone who hasn't seen you do far more). Hold grip on a limb and yank to rip it off. Grab the body to lift and throw.

LOBBY  punch the arrows to pick a level, punch START.

Desktop test: WASD + mouse, click = swipe, hold E / Q = grab, click while holding = yank, release = throw.
